original_test_intent: Have a qualified operator inspect the BIOS CCD/Core/Thread Enablement page and verify every displayed topology and enablement field against the approved CPU/platform specification without changing configuration.
original_method: Bind the exact CPU/socket and BIOS/AGESA identity, prepare a label-level expected topology matrix, traverse the page read-only, capture counts/states/numbering and compare each item under documented disabled, SMT, optional and platform-specific semantics; preserve logs and exit unchanged.
manual_activity: A qualified operator verifies CPU and firmware identity, records every CCD/core/thread field on the BIOS page and compares it with the approved physical-versus-enabled topology matrix without making a change.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, socket and CPU SKU/topology
Owner-approved CCD/core/thread field, count and enablement matrix
Physical, enabled, disabled, SMT and numbering semantics
Protected screenshot/evidence path and redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep all CCD/core/thread, SMT, boost, power and performance controls unchanged
Do not inherit the writable AMD CBS checkpoint from row 1563
Do not treat OS logical-CPU enumeration as proof of BIOS page values
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL
Stop on unexpected topology, inaccessible fields, a changed setting or boot/CPU warning
No automatic retry or defaults reset
agent_execution_scope: Support read-only CPU identity and lscpu/topology collection
Coordinate but do not claim BIOS UI control
Reconcile operator captures with physical and enabled topology semantics
Record ambiguity and mismatches without assigning verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the expected CCD/core/thread topology and numbering basis
Define disabled, optional and SMT acceptance rules
Perform or supervise complete BIOS traversal
Resolve topology discrepancies and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: NO/manual is correct, but `view/modify AMD CBS` and save language are not commands for this row's read-only CCD/Core/Thread information check.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual operator: verify CPU and firmware identity, enter Advanced -> CCD/Core/Thread Enablement, capture every displayed topology/state field and compare it with the approved matrix without changing settings.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CCD/Core/Thread page, information comparison and 20/20-minute estimates remain; log clearing and any configuration write are prohibited.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL READ-ONLY CCD CORE THREAD TOPOLOGY RECONCILIATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a matrix of BIOS label, expected physical resource, enabled resource, numbering domain, SMT/disabled semantics, observed value and evidence reference.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines the topology oracle and separates this row from the writable AMD CBS duplicate variant.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS topology can corroborate enabled runtime resources but cannot replace BIOS page coverage or prove disabled/hidden resources.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware and CPU-family differences may expose non-equivalent labels or numbering, and a wrong interpretation can mask disabled compute capacity.

project_override_considerations: Project-specific core-disable or licensing policies may alter the expected enabled topology, but they must be documented in the row-1572 matrix. Any configuration change is separately approved work and is not authorized here.
expected_evidence: Approved physical-versus-enabled CCD/core/thread matrix and numbering rules
Protected capture of every requested BIOS field and state
Optional complete read-only OS topology marked supporting only
Field/count/state discrepancy and ambiguity report plus preserved boot/event evidence
No-mutation record and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test Set, Procedure and Criteria consistently request a read-only CCD/Core/Thread information comparison. DeepSeek's shared write wording and the earlier duplicate code are reference-layer contamination, not a contradiction in the Master row.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The inspection is safely defined once the owner supplies the version-specific topology matrix and numbering rules and a qualified operator can capture the page.

review_improvement: Separates the duplicate-code AMD CBS mutation case and makes the physical/enabled topology, SMT, disabled-state and numbering oracle explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BIOS count may describe physical CCDs, enabled cores, logical threads or an indexed configuration control; those are not interchangeable. The review therefore binds each displayed label to a defined topology domain before comparison and treats runtime OS enumeration only as supporting evidence.
